content.summary: F3 completed both semantic reconsideration cycles, retaining twelve encoded candidates in three behavior groups, four deferred proposals and explicit unresolved criticism. The final finite-domain comparison replayed 768 Java/Python evaluations. A pre-F4 repair now preserves non-executable readings without forcing a formula; 24 targeted tests passed.
findings: The accepted pre-F4 implementation is archived. The revised validation requires explicit unresolved questions for a non-executable reading and retains it for criticism; it contributes no fabricated Java results.
F4 carries every rejected F3 generation proposal and recoverable non-executable reading into the packaged uncertainty record. No old response is edited or treated as an independent opinion.
Build both trigger candidates with the exact selected question and neutral predicate descriptor; no candidate is selected as an authoritative winner.
All 64 trigger states per candidate are checked. Package source hashes, host bytecode and descriptor must match the compiled bundle.
This phase uses no model calls. Business classification, source-edition relationship and bank-specific integration remain unresolved; packages stay draft.
